hooks.command: file_path=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | jq -r '.file_path // .new_file_path // empty'); if echo "$file_path" | grep -q '\.java$'; then cd smart-admin-api-java21-springboot3 && ./gradlew spotlessApply -q 2>/dev/null; fi

file_path=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | jq -r '.file_path // .new_file_path // empty'); if echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '\.(tsx?|jsx?)$'; then cd smart-admin-web-react && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20; fi
if echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | grep -qiE '(DROP TABLE|TRUNCATE|DELETE FROM|ALTER TABLE.*DROP|rm -rf)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Destructive operation detected' >&2; exit 2; fi
cd smart-admin-api-java21-springboot3 && echo '--- ArchUnit Test ---' && ./gradlew :smartadmin-app:test --tests ArchitectureTest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
